Well we weren't really sure, but perhaps now we can piece it together.
Well well! You are good with cats! Here, I have a little present for you...
Well with how white your robes are, I assumed that you'd know a thing or two about keeping clothes clean.
Well you never know, now can I get back please?
Well, Darkmeyer is always in need of more vials of blood. I am also willing to help those that show they've contributed to controlling the stymphike population here.
Well, Father Sugadinti has been using their sap in his research, but it also has other benefits that you might appreciate.
Well, I *hic*...disagree.
Well, I can offer you a teleport to Barbarian Village. It is a fine place to be checked! However, I can only do this once!
Well, I can see you have a tinderbox already, but I can give you an axe to go with it.
Well, I can see you have an axe already, but I can give you a tinderbox to go with it.
Well, I can tell you about rewards or customisable load-outs. Which would you like to discuss?
Well, I can't see any more candy-hungry adults. I should return to Henja and Angel.
Well, I could tell Sugadinti about you collecting tithes...
Well, I do actually have a bounty available at the moment that you might be interested in. 1,000 coins to whoever can bring justice to some thieves that robbed the General Store.
Well, I do have a love of 2nd Age pottery.
Well, I do have one spare, but it doesn't look like you have room to carry it.
Well, I do know a bit about crafting. I'm sure I can teach you a thing or two...
Well, I expect you to offer him your full assistance in whatever he needs.
Well, I have it in the bank.
Well, I have one of your boots... if that helps?
Well, I have some water from the Salve here.
Well, I just wonder... what if we had even more bones!
Well, I s'pose we'd best...
Well, I split this rock in your camp in two, you see, and I'm going to give half of it to Brundt so he will speak to you.
Well, I suppose I can. I'll be back soon.
Well, I suppose I have ended up learning a bit about crafting as part of this job.
Well, I suppose you can't be too picky.
Well, I suppose you could pray to other gods... but I don't know why you'd want to. What could any other god possibly offer that Saradomin does not already provide?
Well, I surely cannot deny you the cape now. There is of course a fee...
Well, I was collecting bones for you... but then you killed me! Then we were in some sort of asylum... with this creature you'd been building! I managed to kill it though.
Well, I was just going to ask what you're doing, but I'm starting to regret it.
Well, I went to the temple and spoke to... Drezel. He asked me to kill a dog in the mausoleum.

Well, I will not allow this ignominious incident to sully this otherwise resplendent day. Now, I beseech thee, be gone with alacrity. I wish to partake in beverages without the trouble of your presence.

Well, I would be more than happy to take you, unfortunately the Moon Clan are, frankly, very scary people, and I believe they would not take kindly to us bringing a Fremennik there.No line from the player in this case.
Well, I'd appreciate a bit more o ya help! Ain't got two bees t'rub togetha' and now we got wasps squattin' in me 'ives!
Well, I'd be lying if I said life was suddenly perfect, but it's nice to no longer live in constant fear of the vampyres.
Well, I'd love to be able to help you for free again, but I'm afraid I don't have the spare materials lying around this time.
Well, I'm afraid I'm going to have to put a stop to that. Whatever it is you're doing... it ends here!
Well, I'm glad it's going well for you.
Well, I'm not old enough to remember the full story behind it, but it was a terrible day for these lands when it was built there.
Well, I'm the steward here at Lumbridge Castle. It's my job to make sure the Duke has everything he needs to keep things running smoothly.
Well, I've left a list of all the ones I need just on the wall there. Do check it if you need a reminder of which ones you still need to fetch.
Well, Ok, I'm going to need a pigeon cage to convert it, plus some money for my time, say [a 100 gold/100 gold per cage]?
Well, [vampyre name], you're wrong. No one can go in the Arboretum, by order of the Drakan family themselves.
Well, an adventurer like you may find them very useful in battle. They can make you stronger, letting you defeat powerful enemies with ease.
Well, as a matter of fact, I will not have to organise anything, there is a particularly vicious and dangerous criminal currently at loose!
Well, as it turns out, Mudfoot here is actually trying to deal with the thieves as well.
Well, as those fiends pointed out to me with delight, as I am the descendant of one of the Seven Priestly Warriors who blessed the river, it will likely recognise the smell of my blood.
Well, at least we're makin' the best o' a bad job.
Well, best you get back to it then. This is a matter of national security and if I find out we are vulnerable I will hold you personally responsible!
Well, don't forget that you'll be needing that book to do so. I'm sure Allanna over at the Farming Guild will have a copy.
Well, don't give up adventurer! The key must be nearby. Most likely the leader of those Zamorakians has it. I believe he's the one in the hood.
Well, don't keep me waiting! I must hear what they think.
Well, er sort of. I got to his camp and I encountered a spirit of some kind. I don't think it was a Ghast, it tried to communicate with me, but made no sense, it was all 'ooooh' this and 'oooh' that.
Well, er... pleased to meet you, Zanik.
Well, everybody needs a hobby.
Well, first up, there are three types of combat: melee, ranged and magic. Melee uses close up weapons like swords and warhammers, whereas ranged uses things like bows, crossbows or throwing knives.
Well, from what a neighbour overheard, the killer was likely known to the victim.
Well, given you'd been gone for a while, I thought I'd best come make sure my brother hadn't found you.
Well, go get a new one. And throw that... thing... away!
Well, hang on... What about the local butcher?
Well, he's alive, but otherwise, not great. He doesn't seem to remember anything.

Well, if it wasn't for me, you might never have found the Myreque. On one hand, that might mean they'd not have ended up getting killed, but on the other, the Drakans might never have been overthrown.
Well, if nothing else, I suppose the odd blunder will keep you guessing.
Well, if this isn't quite the swing in power.
Well, if yer want ye can hunt some more o' the birds an' wasps here. If ya don't fancy that, I 'eard lots o' funny coloured birds 'ave popped up recently in places not too far from 'ere.
Well, if you think it will do any good... here goes then-
Well, in general you'll find that practice makes perfect. The best way to improve a skill is to quite simply keep working at it.
Well, in that case, I think I'll give it a miss.
Well, in that case, what's not to trust. What challenges do you have available for me?
Well, in truth, I'm not really sure. I think you've managed to reach a point where my advice isn't really going to be useful any more. I'd say it's all on you now.
Well, is there anything I can help you with, [player name]?
Well, it certainly will help... -- The guard takes the five gold coins. -- Now then, what did you want to know?
Well, it's nice to not have to worry as much about the vampyres, but I must admit, I'm still not overly comfortable about the fact that we're now all trying to be friends.
Well, it's not like anything nefarious if that's what you're worried about... Not any more at least...
Well, it's safe to say I've had better days. It's not looking good for us at all.
Well, it's still a bit early to suggest too much. That said, this one doesn't look good.
Well, just grab a pot, add some vinegar, stick the bones in, then boil them on a fire or range. I get my vinegar from a Wine Merchant in Draynor called Fortunato.
Well, keep at it.
Well, let us know how it goes.
Well, let's have a look...
Well, let's hope we can explain that to them when they come to question us.
Well, like I say, this is a mostly peaceful town, so we don't have too many issues... though I suppose it is true that one or two problems do crop up from time to time...
Well, make it quick.
Well, maybe I could help. I could do some investigating of my own.

Well, melee often works best against an opponent using ranged, ranged typically works best when fighting an opponent using magic, and magic is normally the best option when fighting someone using melee.
